title: Quentin and the Gravity
author: Oscar Oyelaran
blurb: Ada Vasquez, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
